boardNames: American Board of Anesthesiology (ABA) initial certification pathway: BASIC, ADVANCED, APPLIED (SOE/OSCE); in-training exam is a programme assessment, not a specialty board.

No separate ABA Perioperative Medicine board/subspecialty certification or dedicated examination identified as of 2026-10-07. ABA announced a perioperative-medicine content-outline topic, with related exam questions beginning in 2028.
boardStatus: This BWH-named physician fellowship is a programme title, not a distinct ABA board. The ABA lists its initial anesthesiology examinations (BASIC, ADVANCED, APPLIED) and subspecialty exams. ABA and ASA announced on 2026-07-22 that perioperative medicine is a newly defined clinical topic within the initial-certification content outline; related new exam questions are scheduled to appear beginning in 2028. No separate Perioperative Medicine board examination/certification was identified in the reviewed ABA material as of 2026-10-07.
boardEligibilityNotice: Completion of this independent course does not confer eligibility for ABA initial certification or an ABA subspecialty exam. Eligibility must be verified directly against current ABA requirements and the relevant accredited training pathway. The BWH webpage publicly describes a 12-month fellowship with attending anesthesiologist clinical work and administrative, research and didactic components; the webpage does not establish ACGME accreditation or a separate board eligibility pathway.
